summary.text: A 75-year-old non-smoking woman with stage IV EGFR exon 19 deletion lung adenocarcinoma, confirmed on 11 September 2023, took erlotinib from 16 September 2023, stopped it on 14 October 2023 with grade 3 exfoliative dermatitis, and started osimertinib on 16 November 2023. Osimertinib was stopped on 16 December 2023 with progressive respiratory symptoms and hypoxemia. On 28 December 2023 she presented with fever, dyspnea at rest, dry cough and anorexia.

She had tachypnea, tachycardia and bilateral coarse crackles. CT showed diffuse bilateral ground-glass opacities with septal thickening, with absolute lymphocyte count 0.48 ×10^(9)/L and CRP 47.81 mg/L. Drug-induced ILD was favored and empiric antibiotics started. BAL-NGS identified MAC DNA on 5 January 2024 despite BAL neutrophilia of 32% and no cavitation; anti-MAC therapy and methylprednisolone were given.

Erlotinib was rechallenged on 7 January 2024 with a fall in lymphocytes from 2.13 to 1.28 ×10^(9)/L. Follow-up CT on 12 January showed progression, and she was discharged on 16 January on antimycobacterials. Erlotinib was stopped on 8 February. She was readmitted on 18 February 2024 with fever, cough, hypotension and hypoxemia; BAL-PCR showed CMV 20,000 copies/mL with CD4+ lymphocytes 0.16 ×10^(9)/L, and ganciclovir started on 21 February.

After ganciclovir, virologic clearance below 500 copies/mL was reported by day 7 and complete symptom resolution by day 21. She was discharged on 8 March 2024 with residual dyspnea (mMRC grade 2). CT on 1 May 2024 showed irreversible fibrotic remodeling with traction bronchiectasis; FVC was 48% and DLCO 42%, with long-term oxygen of 2–4 L/min and palliative care. Fibrotic changes were stable on CT on 12 March 2025.

Table 2 and the Discussion are recommendations and hypotheses (immune-fibrotic axis) and are not recorded as patient facts; Supplementary Figure S1 is a hypothetical schematic.

Figure 2 prints chart values (lymphocyte and white blood cell counts) inside the image; those are pixel content kept in visual.json only, so any text or table fact for the same quantity is not merged with them.
The Introduction, Discussion and Figure 2 use fatal, lethal or terminal wording while no death is reported.
Several procedure and medication statuses use required, discharged on or listed-in-row wording and are recorded with unknown action where completion or current use is not stated.
